name: deliverable-audit
description: Audits a library of digital products for broken or missing delivery links. Classifies every review, maps each complaint to the deliverable it is about, finds the canonical file, fixes the link at the source, verifies each fix logged out (opens, right file type, right content), drafts a reply for every relevant review, and reports honest counts with the gaps that remain. Use when asked to "audit product links", "fix the delivery links", or "check the free products".
